# OpenAI Realtime API with the Agents SDK

Always use the Agents SDK for Realtime functionality. The SDK provides high-level abstractions that simplify integration with OpenAI's Realtime API.

## Always use the latest documentation and guides

For every Realtime API related request, begin by searching for the most current Realtime API documentation, guides, and examples.

Use the following tools to fetch and search documentation if they are available:

- `fetch` to get the latest information from the web.
- `githubRepo` to get information from GitHub repositories.

## Agents SDK high-level documentation

- [OpenAI Agents Documentation for Voice Agents](https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-js/guides/voice-agents/)
- [Voice Agents Quickstart](https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-js/guides/voice-agents/quickstart/)
- [Building Voice Agents](https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-js/guides/voice-agents/build/)
- [OpenAI Agents SDK GitHub Repo](https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-js)

## Agents SDK Realtime API reference

### Classes:

URL: `https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-js/openai/agents-realtime/classes/[className]`

`className` options are:

- `ModelBehaviorError`
- `OpenAIRealtimeBase`
- `OpenAIRealtimeSIP`
- `OpenAIRealtimeWebRTC`
- `OpenAIRealtimeWebSocket`
- `OutputGuardrailTripwireTriggered`
- `RealtimeAgent`
- `RealtimeSession`
- `UserError`

### Interfaces:

URL: `https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-js/openai/agents-realtime/interfaces/[interfaceName]`

`interfaceName` options are:

- `RealtimeOutputGuardrail`
- `RealtimeTransportLayer`

### Type Aaliases:

URL: `https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-js/openai/agents-realtime/type-aliases/[typeAlias]`

`typeAlias` options are:

- `ApiKey`
- `FunctionTool`
- `OpenAIRealtimeBaseOptions`
- `OpenAIRealtimeEventTypes`
- `OpenAIRealtimeModels`
- `OpenAIRealtimeWebRTCOptions`
- `OpenAIRealtimeWebSocketOptions`
- `RealtimeAgentConfiguration`
- `RealtimeAudioFormat`
- `RealtimeBaseItem`
- `RealtimeClientMessage`
- `RealtimeContextData`
- `RealtimeItem`
- `RealtimeMcpCallItem`
- `RealtimeMessageItem`
- `RealtimeSessionConfig`
- `RealtimeSessionConnectOptions`
- `RealtimeSessionEventTypes`
- `RealtimeSessionOptions`
- `RealtimeSessionPayload`
- `RealtimeToolCallItem`
- `RealtimeTransportEventTypes`
- `RealtimeTransportLayerConnectOptions`
- `TransportError`
- `TransportEvent`
- `TransportLayerAudio`
- `TransportLayerResponseCompleted`
- `TransportLayerResponseStarted`
- `TransportLayerTranscriptDelta`
- `TransportToolCallEvent`
- `WebRTCState`
- `WebSocketState`

### Variables:

URL: `https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-js/openai/agents-realtime/variables/[variable_name]`

`variable_name` options are:

- `DEFAULT_OPENAI_REALTIME_MODEL`
- `DEFAULT_OPENAI_REALTIME_SESSION_CONFIG`
- `utils`

### Functions:

URL: `https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-js/openai/agents-realtime/functions/[functionName]`

`functionName` options are:

- `backgroundResult`
- `isBackgroundResult`
- `tool`
